spot:victor-harbor-4.name: Port Elliot
spot:victor-harbor-4.bio: A historic seaside village on the coast east of Victor Harbor, with a sheltered bay.

spot:victor-harbor-6.name: Urimbirra Wildlife Experience
spot:victor-harbor-6.bio: An open-range wildlife park at Hindmarsh Valley with kangaroo feeding, koala patting and over 70 species of Australian animals.

spot:victor-harbor-7.name: Hindmarsh Falls
spot:victor-harbor-7.bio: A 20 m waterfall best seen in winter and spring, reached by a short walk to a viewing platform.

spot:victor-harbor-8.name: Nakurami Kondoli Whale Lookout
spot:victor-harbor-8.bio: A free whale-watching platform at Kings Beach on the Heysen Trail, near Waitpinga.

spot:victor-harbor-11.name: Middleton
spot:victor-harbor-11.bio: A coastal village east of Port Elliot with a surf beach and a rocky point on the Fleurieu coast.

spot:victor-harbor-12.name: Victor Harbor National Trust Museum
spot:victor-harbor-12.bio: Heritage museum in an 1866 house at Victor Harbor, with period rooms and displays on the town's colonial history.

spot:victor-harbor-13.name: Glacier Rock
spot:victor-harbor-13.bio: Permian glacial pavement in the Inman River bed, with ice-scratched bedrock first recorded by a geologist in 1859.

spot:victor-harbor-14.name: Hindmarsh River Walking Trail
spot:victor-harbor-14.bio: Easy river walk near Victor Harbor through paperbark woodland and past a lagoon, with birdlife along the way.

spot:victor-harbor-15.name: Inman River Trail
spot:victor-harbor-15.bio: Flat riverside walk from Muwerang (Kent Reserve) with a bird hide, ending at Victor Harbor Cemetery.

spot:victor-harbor-16.name: Softfoot Alpaca Farm
spot:victor-harbor-16.bio: A Hindmarsh Valley alpaca farm with guided buggy tours, alpaca feeding and a nocturnal marsupial safari.
